data.query:
query Query($where: ShiftWhereInput, $orderBy: [ShiftOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  shift(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        friday
        monday
        name
        saturday
        sunday
        thursday
        tuesday
        wednesday
        endHour
        endMinute
        startHour
        startMinute
        timeZone
        shiftGroup {
          name
          shiftGroupWorkcenters {
            edges {
              node {
                id
                code
                globalIdealRate
                globalQuotedRate
                globalSetupRate
                globalStandardRate
                hourlyLaborCost
                hourlyOverheadCost
                hourlySetupCost
                maximumConcurrency
                maximumPositions
                productionOffalAllowed
                productionOperators
                setupOffalAllowed
                setupOperators
                active
                requireChangeoverApproval
                requireProductionApproval
                description
                externalId
                name
                plcName
                customData
                modeGroupId
                shiftGroupId
                calendarId
                facilityId
                locationId
                putAwayLocationId
                replenishmentTypeId
                screenId
                workcenterGroupId
                workcenterScheduleMethodId
                workcenterTypeId
              }
            }
          }
        }
        shiftGroupId
      }
    }
  }
}
